key_takeaway: Consolidate Barefoot, Rubaroo, Wheelhouse, and Breezeway into one platform at $29 per property/month — with AI running guest communication, pricing, and operations across your ~190 North Myrtle Beach listings — targeting a November/December 2026 go-live.
summary_bullets: Your 190 listings run on four separate tools today — Barefoot (PMS), Rubaroo (guest comms), Wheelhouse (pricing), and Breezeway (ops). Boom folds all of them into one subscription.
You lose roughly 10 minutes on every manual add-a-night or early-arrival flow. Zoe, Boom's guest AI, handles the confirmation, charge, receipt, and follow-up end to end.

executive_summary: Seaside Vacations manages ~190 vacation rentals in North Myrtle Beach, SC, currently running Barefoot, Rubaroo, Wheelhouse, and Breezeway as separate tools. The team wants to consolidate onto a single platform. Boom Now would replace the entire stack at $29/property/month, with AI agents Zoe (guest-facing) and BAM (company-wide) handling communication, pricing, and operations. Strong buying intent with a target go-live of November/December 2026.

discussion_points.title: Current stack & pain points
items: Four separate subscriptions to consolidate — Barefoot, Rubaroo, Wheelhouse, Breezeway — with a goal of one platform.
Rubaroo's AI features aren't performing, so only canned/automated sequences are in use (~80% of outbound).
Manual guest transactions (add nights, early arrivals) take ~10 minutes each, handled by hand.
Wheelhouse is too complex and has not been fully deployed across all properties.

discussion_points.title: How Boom replaces the stack
items: Multi-calendar with drag-and-drop, mid-stay moves, and split owner payments.
Built-in task management replaces Breezeway — auto-scheduled cleaning, checklists, housekeeper app.
CRM unifies email, SMS, WhatsApp, and OTA channels into one inbox.
Native dynamic pricing replaces Wheelhouse; owner portals with live P&L reduce inbound owner questions.
Full US trust accounting with a reconciliation agent that reads bank transactions and auto-matches.

discussion_points.title: AI-driven growth
items: Zoe designs personalized guest experiences and upsells, not just Q&A.
BAM answers any company question in natural language and builds custom dashboards on demand.
BAM Optimum flags gap nights, listings priced above market, and OTA content gaps — pushing fixes with one click or on autopilot.
Automated re-marketing to high-quality past guests, curated by AI.

discussion_points.title: Timeline & next steps
items: $29 per property/month, replacing the entire existing stack.
3–5 week fully remote onboarding with 24/7 support; ~5 years of history migrated on day one.
Follow-up meeting confirmed for Thursday, July 30 at 5:30 PM EDT.
